title: Honor No More & Eddie Edwards’ betrayal
summary: A group of former Ring of Honor wrestlers fights for a place in Impact. Eddie Edwards abandons the company he once defended and joins the outsiders, bringing their campaign to the world-title picture.

chapters.title: Edwards betrays Team Impact
chapters.result: Eddie helps Honor No More defeat Team Impact and earn contracts.
chapters.context: After apparently being taken out earlier in the night, Edwards returns to attack his supposed allies. Impact’s former standard-bearer becomes the invaders’ central figure.

chapters.title: Alexander stops Edwards’ title bid
chapters.result: Josh Alexander defeats Eddie Edwards to retain the world title.
chapters.context: Honor No More’s interference cannot deliver the championship. Alexander survives a major test of his reign and denies Edwards control of the top prize.
